messages:
Rafael (AE): Heads-up: ArboraTech CISO paused the POC. They want a 1-page exec summary + a minimal runbook proving no uncontrolled outbound egress and 90-day audit exports. Need by Tue AM for their steering committee.
Tara (SE): Copy. Quick Q: Are they demanding Dedicated/Private or will hosted+reserved-egress IPs + retention addon be acceptable?
Maya (SalesOps): They said speed is important but CISO's questionnaire leans toward Dedicated controls. We'll show both paths and call out tradeoffs/pricing.
Eve (Security): Short summary: hosted = per-request logs available, retention >31 days requires retention addon; outbound FQDN blocking per-tenant requires network isolation (Dedicated/Private) or a customer proxy. I'll draft exec wording.
Nolan (Infra): We can offer two options: 1) Hosted w/ reserved NAT IPs (INFRA-8124) + retention addon 2) Dedicated with full tenant-level egress controls. Reserved IPs timeline: 48h after ticket prioritization.
Rafael (AE): Customer also asked for a clear rollback playbook in case allowlist changes break things. Keep it one page.
Tara (SE): I'll draft runbook sections: overview, inbound allowlist (example CIDRs), outbound constraints, log export steps, validation tests, rollback steps. Will include example commands.
Maya (SalesOps): Pricing note: Dedicated = ~+40% MRR vs hosted; retention 90d = fixed monthly. Need approval to show numbers. Rafael ok to show both?
Rafael (AE): Yes show both with clear acceptance criteria. If they care about time-to-PoC, emphasize hosted path plus migration plan.
Eve (Security): Drafting acceptance checklist: ["Reserved NAT IPs verified", "90d log export validated (sample CSV)", "Blocked-host egress attempt logged", "Rollback tested and documented"]. Posting in thread soon.
Nolan (Infra): ticket-bot, open INFRA-8124 to reserve static NAT IPs for tenant-arbora and create ACL template.
ticket-bot: Created INFRA-8124: Reserve static NAT IPs and generate ACL template for tenant-arbora. Assigned to infra-scheduling.
Tara (SE): Sample runbook snippet: ```
Inbound allowlist (examples): 18.144.32.0/24, 34.200.16.0/24
Steps:
- Confirm INFRA-8124 reserved IPs
- Customer adds inbound allowlist to firewall
- Run egress test: `./egress_check.sh --target blocked.example`
- Export logs: /admin/logs/export?tenant=arbora&days=90 -> validate CSV contains request_id
Rollback:
- Revert ACLs to previous commit hash `d4f9a1`
- Reroute traffic to stable model pool
- Notify infra-oncall and customer SRE
```
Maya (SalesOps): I'll draft the legal-ready memo with a short liability paragraph and price appendix. ETA 3 hours.
Eve (Security): Proposed legal blurb: "Redwood provides the described network controls for the POC. Customer and Redwood will jointly validate egress behavior; Redwood is not liable for customer-initiated outbound actions during POC beyond network controls provided." Sending to Legal for review.
Rafael (AE): Can we get INFRA-8124 confirmed by Mon EOD? Customer wants to include NAT IPs in their slide deck.
Nolan (Infra): If infra-scheduling prioritizes, Mon EOD is realistic. Otherwise Tue morning. I'll ping schedulers.
Tara (SE): I'll post the one-page runbook + 2-paragraph exec note here once legal approves wording.
Maya (SalesOps): Noted. I'll include both price scenarios and a short migration plan (hosted -> dedicated).
Rafael (AE): Thanks team. This is high priority for the deal. Please drop final artifacts here; I'll bundle and send to the CISO first thing Tue. :pray:
